target_scope: Current Claude, general guidance; model-specific snapshots are reference-only

rules.rule_text: State the intended task explicitly, including desired outputs and constraints.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Use ordered instructions when execution order or completeness matters.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Explain the purpose, audience, and reasons behind important constraints.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Use relevant examples to demonstrate required formats, tone, and structure.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Vary examples and include edge cases to avoid teaching accidental patterns.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Distinguish examples from instructions using example and examples XML tags.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: The current technical guide suggests three to five relevant examples; do not add examples without a task-specific need.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Separate mixed instructions, context, examples, and inputs with descriptive, consistent XML tags.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Nest XML tags to reflect natural document or data hierarchies.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Use a concise system role to focus behavior and tone.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise
rules.condition: When a role contributes to the task

rules.rule_text: Place long documents before the task query and put the query near the end.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise
rules.condition: Long documents or data-rich inputs around 20k tokens or more

rules.rule_text: Label multiple documents with content and source metadata.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Extract relevant document quotations before analyzing long material.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Provide the actual model identity or exact API identifier if the application needs it; do not guess identifiers.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Explicitly request the desired response length or tool-use summaries instead of relying on defaults.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise
rules.condition: When response length or progress visibility matters

rules.rule_text: Describe the desired output form positively and match prompt formatting to the intended answer.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Use explicit format instructions or output tags when formatting needs tighter control.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Request plain-text mathematics explicitly when LaTeX is unsuitable.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Specify the document goal, visual hierarchy, and any desired interactive or animated elements.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Do not rely on final assistant-turn prefills for Claude 4.6 and later; use explicit formats or supported structured outputs instead.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Resume interrupted output through a user request containing its final text, or retry if appropriate.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Supply refreshed context through supported user messages, tools, or compaction rather than unsupported assistant prefills.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: State whether Claude should execute changes or merely recommend them.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Avoid aggressive tool-triggering instructions carried over from older models; use precise tool conditions.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise
rules.condition: Tool-enabled tasks; re-evaluate for the actual target model

rules.rule_text: Parallelize independent tool calls; execute dependent calls sequentially and never guess missing arguments.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise
rules.condition: Tools available and parallel execution appropriate

rules.rule_text: Use reasoning configurations supported by the actual target model; do not assume one configuration works on every Claude version.
rules.source_section: Leverage thinking and interleaved thinking capabilities
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Prefer general reasoning guidance to a rigid hand-written reasoning plan.
rules.source_section: Leverage thinking and interleaved thinking capabilities
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Worked examples may demonstrate the problem, method, and expected answer.
rules.source_section: Leverage thinking and interleaved thinking capabilities
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: For newer Claude models that keep reasoning in thinking blocks, do not request exposed reasoning in thinking tags; use the supported thinking mode.
rules.source_section: Leverage thinking and interleaved thinking capabilities
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise
rules.condition: Target model supports internal thinking; avoid assumptions about unsupported older models

rules.rule_text: Verification guidance must be model-specific; do not blindly add self-check loops because Opus 5 can over-verify.
rules.source_section: Leverage thinking and interleaved thinking capabilities
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise
rules.condition: Verification-sensitive tasks; target version must be known

rules.rule_text: For models that over-explore, replace blanket investigation defaults with targeted instructions and calibrate effort.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Describe actual compaction and persistence capabilities; save progress before context transitions rather than prematurely ending work.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise
rules.condition: The application really supports context compaction or multiple windows

rules.rule_text: Initialize the environment and test plan in the first window, then continue from recorded tasks and repository state.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise
rules.condition: Long tasks spanning multiple context windows

rules.rule_text: Provide suitable tests and inspection tools for autonomous work instead of relying only on model claims.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Use structured state for test results, free-form notes for progress, and version-control checkpoints where available.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Distinguish reversible local work from destructive or externally visible actions and require appropriate confirmation.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise
rules.condition: Agents able to modify files or external systems

rules.rule_text: Define research success criteria, verify sources, and maintain structured notes for complex research.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Use well-defined subagent tools for independent work when helpful and avoid unnecessary delegation.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Use explicit prompt chains when intermediate outputs must be inspected, logged, evaluated, or branched.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise
rules.condition: A multi-stage workflow genuinely needs observable stages

rules.rule_text: Clean up temporary iteration files when the user wants a minimal final workspace.
rules.source_section: Reduce file creation in agentic coding
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Keep changes scoped to the request and avoid speculative features, abstractions, and unrelated refactoring.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Solve the underlying problem for valid inputs rather than hardcoding test-specific outcomes.
rules.source_section: Avoid focusing on passing tests and hardcoding
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Inspect referenced code before making claims about its behavior.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Offer image crops or zoom tools when detailed visual inspection benefits from them.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise
rules.condition: Vision-capable target and image inspection tools available

rules.rule_text: For frontend work, specify cohesive typography, color, motion, and background direction rather than generic styling.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Medicine-dose guidance is model-dependent and may require an exact official system block; do not synthesize a universal replacement or guess doses.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise
rules.condition: Child medication-dose tasks: review the source blocks and actual target model; no automatic activation

rules.rule_text: When migrating models, re-evaluate prompting, reasoning settings, prefills, and conversation handling rather than copying old scaffolding.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Establish clear success criteria, empirical tests, and a draft prompt before iterative optimization.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Recognize that model selection or system changes may address cost and latency better than prompt wording.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Prefer the current living reference where it differs from older Claude 3 tutorials.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Allow Claude to acknowledge uncertainty and missing information rather than fabricate an answer.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: For factual document tasks, support claims with source quotations or citations and remove unsupported claims.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: When the task is document-bound, explicitly restrict answers to the supplied evidence.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Compare independent answers or refine earlier answers to detect inconsistencies when added cost is justified.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise
rules.condition: High-reliability tasks; not a universal requirement

rules.rule_text: When debugging reasoning, inspect supported summarized thinking blocks instead of assuming visible chain-of-thought output.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Define the exact JSON, XML, or other output structure and required fields.
rules.source_section: Specify the output format you want
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Use representative format examples to improve consistency.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Ground repeated domain-specific answers in retrieved reference material.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise
rules.condition: A retrieval system and reference documents are available

rules.rule_text: Define the persona through system instructions and describe expected responses to relevant scenarios.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Assistant prefilling appears in this guide but is not supported by Claude 4.6 and later; exclude it from the current generic mode.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise
rules.condition: Older compatible models only; superseded for current generic mode

rules.rule_text: Treat tool, document, and search content as untrusted data that cannot override the original request or system instructions.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: JSON-encode third-party strings and label their origin instead of concatenating untrusted text into instructions.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: In API agents, deliver third-party material through tool results, not system prompts; place application instructions in a trusted turn.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise
rules.condition: An API agent with tool_result support

rules.rule_text: Restrict tools, data access, and sensitive actions to the minimum needed.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Screen tool outputs and red-team malicious documents before deploying an agent.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Combine input validation, explicit refusal boundaries, and monitoring; prompts alone are not a complete defense.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Monitor interactions and outputs for emerging attacks and adjust guardrails.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Layer safeguards across a workflow rather than relying on one protective prompt.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Avoid putting sensitive material in prompts merely to hide it with instructions; prompt confidentiality is not guaranteed.
rules.source_section: Before you try to reduce prompt leak
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Minimize unnecessary proprietary context and audit outputs for leaks; use output filtering where appropriate.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Make success criteria specific, measurable, achievable, and relevant.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Evaluate on realistic task distributions including edge cases and automate grading where suitable.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise

rules.rule_text: Use explicit grading rubrics and empirical scores; test grader reliability before scaling.
rules.applies_to: current Claude; general guidance unless condition states otherwise
